questions.stem: In professions, which written form expresses ‘librarian’?

options.misconception: selects ‘muhandis’ whose written shape resembles the target but whose sense differs

questions.explanation: The sense ‘librarian’ is carried by ‘أَمِين مَكْتَبَة’. A person who manages a library. The rival spellings each belong to a different item, so matching only the first letter or the general shape of the word will lead you astray.
questions.hint: Check every consonant of ‘أَمِين مَكْتَبَة’, not just its outline.
